Package com.nexuslink.protocol.db

Class JdbcDriverRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.db.JdbcDriverRegistry
public final class JdbcDriverRegistry extends Object
Catalog of known JDBC drivers — the bundled set (always available) plus the on-demand set (loaded from a user-supplied or downloaded jar). Mirrors the DBeaver/DataGrip model: the app stays small, and heavy/licensed drivers are added when needed.

See TASKS.md §8.1.1 and Decisions Log #9 for the bundling rationale.
